title: CIWorkbench configuration (.ciworkbench.yml)
description: Assigns GitHub Actions workflows to collapsible groups in CIWorkbench. Workflows are matched by their file path (never by display name). Precedence: this file, then a '# ci-workbench-group: <name>' comment inside the workflow file, then the 'Ungrouped' group. Semantic checks that need the repository's actual workflows (unmatched paths, a workflow matched by several groups, duplicate group names) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; CIWorkbench reports them as warnings at run time.

version.description: Configuration format version. Optional; a missing version means 1. CIWorkbench ignores files that declare a version it does not support (and says so) instead of guessing.

groups.description: Groups in display order. A group name may contain '/' to nest groups, e.g. 'Security/Scanning'. The first group whose 'workflows' entry matches a workflow wins.

name.description: Display name. Use '/' to nest (e.g. 'Build & Test/Unit'). Must not start or end with '/' or whitespace and must not contain '//'.

description.description: Optional one-line description shown next to the group.

workflows.description: Workflow file paths assigned to this group, e.g. '.github/workflows/ci.yml'. Matching is case-insensitive on the full path. '*' matches any characters inside one path segment (never '/'), e.g. '.github/workflows/deploy-*.yml'. '**', '?', character classes and whitespace are not supported. A group with no workflows is allowed (for example to give a description to a group filled by workflow comments).
